title: Preventing Falls in Older Adults — Screen, Strengthen, Balance

hook.en: One in three older adults falls each year, and a fall can end independence. Exercise is the best-proven way to prevent falls. Learn to screen, to choose the right exercise and to build it into daily life.
hook.ur: Har saal teen mein se ek buzurg girta hai, aur ek girna khud mukhtari khatam kar sakta hai. Exercise girne se bachao ka sab se behtar sabit shuda tareeqa hai. Screen karna, sahi exercise chunna aur isay rozmarra zindagi mein shamil karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll screen for fall risk, use the timed up and go and the 30-second chair stand, and plan a progressive balance and strength programme such as the Otago exercises, with a safe home set-up.
goal.ur: End tak aap girne ke khatre ki screening karenge, timed up and go aur 30-second chair stand istemal karenge, aur Otago jaise darje war balance aur strength programme ka plan mehfooz ghar ke setup ke saath banayenge.

text.en: Start with two questions: **"Have you fallen in the past year?"** and **"Do you feel unsteady when standing or walking?"** A yes to either means a closer look. Falls rarely have one cause. Weak legs, poor balance, slow reactions, tablets that cause dizziness, poor vision, a slippery floor or a rug can add up. Your job is to find **what you can change**: strength, balance and the home.
text.ur: Do sawalon se shuru karein: **"Kya pichle saal aap gire?"** aur **"Kya khare hone ya chalne mein ladkharahat mehsoos hoti hai?"** Kisi ek ka jawab haan ho to qareeb se dekhein. Girne ki aksar ek wajah nahi hoti. Kamzor taangein, kamzor balance, dheemay reaction, chakkar wali dawaiyan, kamzor nazar, phislan wala farsh ya qaleen sab mil kar khatra banate hain. Aap ka kaam hai woh dhoondna **jo badla ja sakta hai**: taaqat, balance aur ghar.

text.en: Think of balance as a **juggler**: eyes, inner ears, joints and muscles all send information, and the brain keeps the body over its feet. With age, one or two of these slow down. The aim is not to avoid movement, but to **retrain the juggler** by practising small, safe challenges until the body reacts quickly again.
text.ur: Balance ko **jugglar** samjhein: aankhein, kaan ke andar ka nizaam, joints aur muscles sab maloomat bhejte hain aur dimagh jism ko pairon ke oopar rakhta hai. Umar ke saath in mein se ek do dheemay ho jate hain. Maqsad harkat se bachna nahi, balkay chhoti, mehfooz challenges ki mashq se **jugglar ko dobara train karna** hai taake jism phir jaldi react kare.

title.ur: Girne se bachao ki assessment aur plan

steps.title: Screen the risk
steps.detail: Ask about falls in the past year, unsteadiness, fear of falling and tablets. Check lying and standing blood pressure if dizzy on standing, and refer if low. || Khatre ki screening karein

steps.title: Test function
steps.detail: Use the timed up and go (walk three metres and return) and the 30-second chair stand. Slow times or low counts show the need for a programme and give a starting point. || Function test karein

steps.title: Prescribe balance and strength
steps.detail: Use progressive leg strengthening and balance practice, such as the Otago exercises, at least three times a week, with a regular walking plan, increasing difficulty as the person improves. || Balance aur taaqat ka programme dein

steps.title: Make home and habits safer
steps.detail: Remove loose rugs, add lighting and grab rails, advise suitable shoes, and arrange a vision and medicine review. Teach how to get up safely after a fall. || Ghar aur aadatein mehfooz banayein

question.en: Which exercise approach has the strongest evidence for reducing falls?
question.ur: Kaun sa exercise tareeqa girne kam karne ke liye sab se mazboot evidence rakhta hai?

feedback.en: It does not train balance or strength.
feedback.ur: Yeh balance ya taaqat train nahi karti.

feedback.en: Inactivity weakens the legs and raises risk.
feedback.ur: Be-harkati taangein kamzor karti hai aur khatra barhati hai.

text.en: Regular balance and functional strength exercise, three or more times a week
text.ur: Regular balance aur functional strength exercise, haftay mein teen ya zyada baar

feedback.en: Yes — challenging balance and leg-strength exercise reduces falls by about a quarter.
feedback.ur: Haan — challenging balance aur taangon ki strength exercise girne takreeban ek chauthai kam karti hai.

title.en: Timed up and go or 30-second chair stand?
title.ur: Timed up and go ya 30-second chair stand?

rows.en: Stand up, walk three metres, turn, return and sit; record the time
rows.ur: Uthein, teen meter chalein, mudein, wapas aa kar baithein; waqt likhein

rows.en: Count full stands from a chair in 30 seconds with arms crossed
rows.ur: 30 second mein kursi se haath kamar par rakh kar poore khare hone ginein

rows.en: A slow time shows a higher risk of falling
rows.ur: Dheema waqt girne ka zyada khatra batata hai

rows.en: A low count for the person's age and sex
rows.ur: Umar aur jins ke hisab se kam ginti

rows.en: Screen and track balance and mobility
rows.ur: Balance aur mobility ki screening aur nigrani
Waqt ke saath taangon ki taaqat ki nigrani

text.en: **Strong, steady and safe.** Strengthen the legs, challenge the balance and make the home safe. Falls fall when all three improve together.
text.ur: **Mazboot, mutawazin aur mehfooz.** Taangein mazboot karein, balance ko challenge dein aur ghar mehfooz banayein. Girna tab kam hota hai jab teeno saath behtar hon.

text.en: **Giving a leaflet and a good luck.** A one-off sheet of exercises does not reduce falls. Programmes work when someone teaches them, checks the technique, raises the challenge and follows up. Supervise at first, then review every few weeks.
text.ur: **Leaflet dena aur dua dena.** Exercises ki ek dafa ki sheet girne kam nahi karti. Programme tab kaam karte hain jab koi sikhaye, technique check kare, challenge barhaye aur follow-up kare. Shuru mein nigrani karein, phir har kuch haftay mein review.

question.en: A patient takes 18 seconds on the timed up and go and has fallen twice this year. What is the best next step?
question.ur: Patient timed up and go mein 18 second leta hai aur is saal do baar gira hai. Agla behtareen qadam kya hai?

text.en: Start a supervised balance and strength programme and review medicines and the home
text.ur: Nigrani wala balance aur strength programme shuru karein aur dawaiyon aur ghar ka review karein

feedback.en: Yes — this person has a clear fall risk and benefits from exercise and risk review.
feedback.ur: Haan — is shakhs ko girne ka saaf khatra hai aur exercise aur khatra review se faida hoga.

text.en: Advise staying seated most of the day
text.ur: Din bhar zyada tar baithne ka mashwara dein

feedback.en: This weakens the muscles and raises risk.
feedback.ur: Yeh muscles kamzor karta hai aur khatra barhata hai.

text.en: Reassure that falls are a normal part of ageing
text.ur: Tasalli dein ke girna budhape ka normal hissa hai

feedback.ur: Girna aam hai magar rokha ja sakta hai.

question.en: Which finding after a fall needs urgent medical review?
question.ur: Girne ke baad kaun si finding foran medical review maangti hai?

text.en: A blow to the head with drowsiness, vomiting or a severe headache
text.ur: Sar par chot ke saath neend, ulti ya shadeed sar dard

feedback.en: Yes — these may signal a head injury or bleeding.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh sar ki chot ya khoon behne ki nishani ho sakti hain.

text.en: A small bruise on the shin

feedback.ur: Yeh aam taur par maamooli hai.

feedback.en: That is common after a fall.

text.en: **Make the exercises part of the day.** Tie them to routines: leg raises while the kettle boils, sit-to-stand after each meal, heel-to-toe standing at the sink. Set a goal that matters to the person, such as getting to the mosque or playing with a grandchild, and review progress every few weeks.
text.ur: **Exercises ko rozmarra ka hissa banayein.** Inhein routine se jorein: chai ubalte waqt leg raises, har khane ke baad sit-to-stand, sink par heel-to-toe khara hona. Aisa maqsad rakhein jo shakhs ke liye ahem ho, maslan masjid tak jana ya potay ke saath khelna, aur har kuch haftay mein progress dekhein.

question.en: Why is "just walking" not enough to prevent falls?
question.ur: "Sirf chalna" girne se bachne ke liye kaafi kyun nahi?

answer.en: Walking is good for health but does not challenge balance or leg strength enough. The exercises that reduce falls are those that push the limits of balance and strength, such as standing with a narrow base, heel-to-toe walking and sit-to-stand, done regularly and progressed.
answer.ur: Chalna sehat ke liye achha hai magar balance aur taangon ki taaqat ko kaafi challenge nahi karta. Girna kam karne wali exercises woh hain jo balance aur taaqat ki hadood ko dhakelti hain, maslan tang base par khara hona, heel-to-toe chalna aur sit-to-stand, jo regular ki jayein aur barhayi jayein.

beats.patient: An 78-year-old woman has fallen twice this year and fears going out. She takes 16 seconds on the timed up and go, manages 6 chair stands, and her home has loose rugs and poor night lighting.
beats.assessment: These results show a raised fall risk with reduced leg strength and balance, plus clear home hazards.
beats.treatment: Start leg-strengthening and balance exercises three times a week, remove the rugs, improve lighting, review her medicines with her doctor and set a goal to walk to the shop.
beats.reassess: After twelve weeks she takes 12 seconds, manages 10 chair stands, has not fallen and walks to the shop twice a week.

text.en: **Refer urgently** after any fall with head injury and drowsiness, vomiting or severe headache, suspected fracture or inability to bear weight, new confusion, chest pain, palpitations or fainting, or a fall that happened without warning. Do not start balance exercises until a new cause such as low blood pressure or a heart rhythm problem has been checked.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** sar ki chot ke saath neend, ulti ya shadeed sar dard, shak wale fracture ya wazan na utha pane, nayi uljhan, seene ka dard, dharkan ya behoshi ke saath girne, ya baghair kisi ishare ke girne par. Balance exercises tab tak shuru na karein jab tak kam blood pressure ya dil ki dharkan jaisi nayi wajah check na ho jaye.

summary.en: Screen with two questions (a fall in the past year, feeling unsteady), then test function with the timed up and go and the 30-second chair stand.
summary.ur: Do sawalon se screen karein (pichle saal girna, ladkharahat), phir timed up and go aur 30-second chair stand se function test karein.

summary.en: Progressive balance and leg-strength exercise, at least three times a week, reduces falls by about a quarter; it works when taught, checked and followed up.
summary.ur: Darje war balance aur taangon ki taaqat ki exercise, haftay mein kam az kam teen baar, girne takreeban ek chauthai kam karti hai; yeh tab kaam karti hai jab sikhayi, check ki aur follow-up ki jaye.

summary.en: Make the home safer, review medicines and vision, and refer urgently for head injury, fracture or unexplained fainting.
summary.ur: Ghar mehfooz banayein, dawaiyon aur nazar ka review karein, aur sar ki chot, fracture ya be-wajah behoshi par foran refer karein.

front.en: What two questions screen for fall risk?
front.ur: Girne ke khatre ki screening ke do sawal kaun se hain?

back.en: A fall in the past year and feeling unsteady on standing or walking.
back.ur: Pichle saal girna aur khare hone ya chalne mein ladkharahat.

back.en: A home programme of leg strengthening and balance exercises plus walking, taught by a trained therapist.
back.ur: Taangon ki strengthening, balance exercises aur chalne ka ghar ka programme jo trained therapist sikhata hai.

front.en: How often should fall-prevention exercise be done?
front.ur: Girne se bachao ki exercise kitni baar karni chahiye?

back.en: At least three times a week.
back.ur: Haftay mein kam az kam teen baar.

front.en: Name two home changes that reduce falls.
front.ur: Ghar mein do tabdeeliyan batayein jo girna kam karti hain.

back.en: Remove loose rugs and improve lighting (also grab rails and suitable shoes).
back.ur: Dheelay qaleen hatana aur roshni behtar karna (saath rails aur munasib joote).

note.en: How to test balance and judge fall risk in detail.
note.ur: Balance ka test aur girne ke khatre ka tafseeli andaza.

note.en: Practise the timed up and go and chair stand tests.
note.ur: Timed up and go aur chair stand tests practise karein.
